cards.title: Unearned Weight
cards.body: You know that feeling – the low hum of guilt that follows you, even when you haven't actually done anything wrong? It often sneaks in when you set a boundary, say no, or simply prioritize your own needs for a change. This constant guilt isn't always about a genuine mistake; it’s often a deeply ingrained reflex, a way your system tries to keep the peace. But what if pausing to question its source is the first step towards letting that heavy feeling go?
cards.caption:
It’s okay to acknowledge that familiar feeling without letting it dictate your choices. What’s one small step you can take to question your guilt today?

video_reels.title: Tender Ache
video_reels.line: The tender ache of missing someone isn't just about their absence; it's your heart reminding you of all the tiny, specific ways they make ordinary moments feel truly extraordinary.
